name: BlueJeans Virtual Meetings
description_en:
BlueJeans Meetings is a historical conferencing product. Verizon’s official service guide states that new sales ended on August 8, 2023 and renewals are not permitted.

This notice establishes a sales/renewal restriction, not a verified final shutdown date for every existing contract. The original product URL could not be read; no current operating plan, price or migration route is established. Previous directory features are historical discovery information.
description_zh:
BlueJeans Meetings 是历史会议产品。Verizon 官方服务指南说明，自 2023 年 8 月 8 日起不再向新客户提供服务，并且不允许续约。

此公告确立停售/续约限制，不能据此核实所有既有合同的最终停服日。原产品网址无法读取，未确立当前运营套餐、价格或迁移路径。原目录功能仅为历史发现信息。

faq.question_en: What does BlueJeans Virtual Meetings do?
faq.question_zh: BlueJeans Virtual Meetings 用来做什么？
faq.answer_en: BlueJeans Virtual Meetings is a product in the Video conferencing category. Its directory profile covers Guest users, Notification Blocker, Participant Permissions, Hand Raising, Meeting Scheduler, Audio Conferencing, Switch Presenter, Live Preview.
faq.answer_zh: BlueJeans Virtual Meetings 属于视频会议软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括访客用户、通知屏蔽、参与者权限、举手发言、会议安排、音频会议、演示者切换、实时预览。

faq.answer_en: Guest users, Notification Blocker, Participant Permissions, Hand Raising, Meeting Scheduler, Audio Conferencing, Switch Presenter, Live Preview, Virtual Whiteboard, HD Video Streaming, Annotation and Markup Tools, File Sharing, Session Recording, Remote Control, Screen Sharing, Polls (Voting), Live Chat
